---
title: "Guide"
---

The guide is split into two kinds of page. Concepts explain how the framework
thinks, so you build the right mental model. How-to pages walk you through one task
at a time, from your first primitive to multi-step workflows. When you want
exhaustive facts, full signatures, the complete event, condition, primitive, and
matcher tables, and every verdict type, read the
[Reference](../reference/index.qmd); the guide links there instead of restating it.

## Concepts (understand)

Read these to learn how captain-hook fits together before you write a rule.

- [How It Works](how-it-works.qmd) traces the full path from a Claude Code event to the JSON response that controls it, covering registration and the lifecycle.
- [Design Philosophy](philosophy.qmd) explains why a hook is data instead of a script, and when plain `settings.json` hooks are enough.
- [Security & Trust](security.qmd) covers the trust boundary, where LLM credentials come from, and why `uvx` never touches your project.

## How-to (get a task done)

Each page is one task with the shortest correct path. Start in Foundation, then
reach for Intermediate and Advanced as you need them. For complete, runnable hooks
to copy and adapt, see the [Examples](../examples/index.qmd).

### Foundation

Start here. [Primitives](primitives.qmd) writes a one-line hook with `nudge`,
`gate`, `lint`, or `block_command`. [Conditions](conditions.qmd) fires a hook only
when typed condition objects match. [Testing](testing.qmd) proves a hook with
inline tests and mock events.

### Intermediate

- [Style Rules](styleguide.qmd) authors AST-based style checks as data and registers them.
- [LLM Hooks](llm-hooks.qmd) gates or nudges with an LLM evaluating the event.
- [Query the transcript](transcript.qmd) reads the conversation history inside a handler.
- [Signals](signals.qmd) scores patterns across the transcript to drive a nudge.
- [Real-World Patterns](patterns.qmd) collects hooks distilled from a production hooks directory, ready to copy and adapt.
- [Packs](packs.qmd) enables versioned hook collections, builtin (`general`, `python`) or from GitHub, instead of copying files into your repo.

### Advanced

- [State & Sessions](state.qmd) persists data across hook invocations.
- [Workflows](workflows.qmd) enforces a multi-step checklist before the agent can stop.
- [Session reviewer](session-reviewer.qmd) mines your ended sessions for durable corrections and opens hook PRs automatically.
- [Watch corrections become hooks](corrections-lifecycle.qmd) reads `capt-hook status` to track each correction from watching to a merged PR.
- [Configuration](configuration.qmd) tunes `HooksSettings`, the env prefix, and the state and log directories.
- [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.qmd) diagnoses common errors with the right command.
